June 10, 1925.

REPORT ON Strike Situation :- Important Happenings, Meetings,
Propaganda, Etc.

Made by C. D. I. Givens Forwarded by Director of Criminal Intelligence

Sir,

Twenty students from a school in Nanking arrived
in Shanghai from Hangchow by rail at 5.15 p.m. June 9. Ten
of these are staying at Poyang Hotel, 516 Hwa An Fong (華安坊),
North Chekiang Road, O.O.L., while the remainder are living
in Ta An Hotel (泰安) on Boulevard des deux Républiques,
near New North Gate.

A committee meeting of the Federation of Street
Unions was held at 2 p.m. June 9, at the Lih Dah (立達中學)
Middle School in Hwang Ka Chuh (黃家闕路) Road, near West
Gate. There were nine persons present. The following resolutions
were discussed and passed :-

1- That with a view to preparing the way for the re-opening
of shops, the Commissioner for Foreign Affairs be requested
to notify the Consular Body to withdraw the armed police,
marines and Volunteers from the Settlement, release all
students in custody, and cancel martial law.

2- That the Chamber of Commerce be requested to prepare the
way for the re-opening of the shops in the Settlement as
the owners have already suffered heavy losses.

3- That Tseng Tsong Kan (曾宗鑑), Vice Minister for Foreign
Affairs, and Admiral Tsai Ting Kan (蔡廷幹), the two
delegates appointed by the Central Government to settle
the strike, be requested to discuss the matter with the
British and Japanese Consuls in Shanghai instead of conducting
the negotiations in Peking.

The meeting was presided over by Zung Yih Ding (陳翊庭).

上海公共租界工部局警务处。

情报办公室分站。
1925年6月10日。

关于罢工局势的报告：重要事件、集会、
宣传等。

由 C. D. I. Givens 制作，经刑事情报处处长转发

先生，

6月9日下午5时15分，二十名南京某校学生
乘火车从杭州抵达上海。其中十人住在北浙江路
华安坊（Hwa An Fong）516号的波阳旅馆（Poyang Hotel），
其余人员则住在靠近新北门的共和双路（Boulevard des deux Républiques）
上的泰安旅馆（Ta An Hotel）。

6月9日下午2时，马路商界联合会在西门附近
黄家阙路（Hwang Ka Chuh）的立达中学（Lih Dah Middle School）
召开委员会会议。共有九人出席。讨论并通过了以下决议：

1- 鉴于为商店复业做准备，请交涉员通知领事团
从租界撤走武装警察、海军陆战队和万国商团，释放所有
被拘留的学生，并取消戒严令。

2- 请总商会为租界内商店的复业做准备，因为
店主们已经遭受了重大损失。

3- 请中央政府指派解决罢工的两位代表，即外交部
次长曾宗鉴（Tseng Tsong Kan）和蔡廷幹海军上将（Admiral Tsai Ting Kan），
在上海与英国和日本领事讨论此事，而不是在
北京进行谈判。

会议由陈翊庭（Zung Yih Ding）主持。

and members of the Chinese Students' Union was held on the
afternoon of June 9 in a theatre in the Chinese City to
discuss the strike. A general discussion marked by moderation
took place, but no resolutions were passed. The attendance
included Chang Yih Peng (張一鵬), formerly Vice Minister of

(黃鎮盤), Tsha Kyi Bai (蔡滬培) and Jiao Kuang (巢),
all of whom are lawyers. The questions which the meeting
attempted to solve were (a) whether the present movement
is anti-foreign and (b) whether the shooting by the police
was necessary for in the interests of self defence. A student
named Sun Tso Chi (孫祖基) presided, and was assisted by
Dong Auh (唐豪), a prominent member of the National Salvation
"Ten Men Group" Society. After the meeting had been called
to order, Wong Chia Chang (王開疆) said that the present
matter was both a diplomatic and legal question. He then
attacked the British people alleging that they held immense
powers. A request for moderation was here injected by Mr.
Dong Auh (唐豪). Continuing the speaker said that the
present treaties were very "unequal" and should be revised.
Chinese interests in the Settlement of Shanghai were by far
greater than those of foreigners, but Chinese were not allowed

June 10 1925

REPORT ON intelligence matters.

Made by Tan Shao Liang Forwarded by
Clerical Assistant.

Sir,

The workmen (totalling about 4000) of three Chinese
cotton mills viz the Pu Yi 益, Robison Road and Tonquin
Road corner, the Hung Yu 鸿裕 Nankhan Road and the Tung Yih 统益
Lohansan Road resumed work yesterday morning.

About twenty labour delegates met at 5 p.m. yesterday
at No.2 Paoshan Road when they discussed how to deal with a
rice shop called Poo Hsi Tai 浦泰 in Ferry Road which is
alleged to have supplied Japanese with rice. Some of those
present suggested to attack the shop and rob the contents
but others objected pointing out that it would lead to
Police intervention. The meeting decided to report the
matter to Mr. Fung Cho Poh 冯佐伯 of the Chinese Chamber of
Commerce and ask him to impose a fine on the shopkeeper.

At a meeting held at 8 p.m. yesterday at Tse Tsz Wei
Chapel, when about forty persons were present, Liu Co
stated that he had received news from the Peking University
to the effect that Tuan Chi Jui had agreed to send troops
to Shanghai to protect the Chinese residents.

Two foreign employees' Associations have been formed
in Chinese territory, one is located in the Shiangshan
Provincial Association, West Jukong Road, Urpei, the
members are composed of Chinese employees in foreign houses and the
other is at 55 Nanchung Road, the membership is composed
of Chinese employed as houseboys, amahs, etc, in foreign
residences.

1925年6月10日

关于情报事项的报告。

由谭绍良（Tan Shao Liang）制作 转呈者
文书助理。

阁下，

三家中国棉纺厂的工人（共计约4000人），即位于罗宾森路（Robison Road）与通金路（Tonquin Road）拐角处的普益纱厂（Pu Yi）、南坎路（Nankhan Road）的鸿裕纱厂（Hung Yu）以及罗汉山路（Lohansan Road）的统益纱厂（Tung Yih），已于昨日上午复工。

约二十名劳工代表于昨日下午5时在宝山路2号集会，讨论如何处理位于斐伦路（Ferry Road）的一家名为浦泰（Poo Hsi Tai）的米店，该店被指控向日本人供应大米。部分与会者建议袭击该店并抢劫店内物品，但其他人表示反对，指出这将导致警方介入。会议决定将此事宜报告给中国商会的冯佐伯（Fung Cho Poh）先生，并请他对店主处以罚款。

昨晚8时在耶稣堂（Tse Tsz Wei Chapel）举行的一次会议上，约有四十人出席，刘科（Liu Co）称他收到来自北京大学的消息，称段祺瑞已同意派遣军队前往上海保护中国居民。

在华界成立了两个外籍雇员协会，一个位于虹口朱恭路（West Jukong Road）的香山会馆，成员由在外商洋行工作的中国雇员组成；另一个位于南昌路55号，成员由在外籍人士住宅中担任男仆、保姆等的中国雇员组成。

REPORT ON General Situation.

Made by D. S. Tinkler. Forwarded by [签名]

Sir,

The situation in the Settlement has improved to some extent during the past twenty-four hours. Reports from all districts indicate that employes on strike are returning to work in increasing numbers and improvements are steadily being made in the public transport services. The reports show show also an almost complete absence of disturbances in all districts, but literature advocating by means of entreaty and threats an extension of the strike is still being distributed by mail and surreptitiously by hand. In contrast with the tranquillity of the Settlement, agitators are still active in Chinese territory, where a rather serious shooting case was recorded.

About 6.30 p.m. June 9th. some coolies employed at the Manufacture Ceramique de Shanghai ( Brick factory ) 100, Brenan or 250, Jessfield Road, interfered with some female workers leaving the Sung Shing Cotton Mill, Brenan Road, which is close to the brick works. It is not thought that this has any connection with strike agitation.

One of the coolies was arrested by members of the Chinese Merchant Volunteers and detained at the Volunteer H. Q. on Brenan Road, not far from the scene.

About 100 other coolies, mostly fellow employes, led by a Chinese foreman from the brick works went to the Volunteer H. Q. and demanded his release, and, on this being refused, created a disturbance. The volunteers fired about 15 pistol and rifle shots seriously wounding one of the coolies who was taken to the Red Cross Hospital. One of the volunteers was wounded in the groin

情报科中央分局。
1925年6月10日。

关于总体局势的报告。

由丁克勒（D. S. Tinkler）制作。转呈者 [签名]

阁下，

在过去二十四小时内，租界内的局势有所改善。来自各区的报告表明，罢工雇员正越来越多地返回工作岗位，公共交通服务也在稳步改善。报告还显示，各区几乎完全没有发生骚乱，但通过邮寄和秘密手工分发的方式，仍在散布通过恳求和威胁手段扩大罢工的宣传品。与租界的平静形成对比的是，煽动者在华界依然活跃，那里记录了一起较为严重的枪击案件。

6月9日下午6时30分左右，一些受雇于上海制瓷厂（砖厂）（Manufacture Ceramique de Shanghai，位于布伦南路100号或极司菲尔路250号）的苦力，干扰了一些离开位于布伦南路、紧邻砖厂的松盛纱厂（Sung Shing Cotton Mill）的女工。人们认为这与罢工煽动无关。

其中一名苦力被华商义勇队成员逮捕，并拘禁在离现场不远的布伦南路义勇队总部。

约100名其他苦力，大多是同事，由砖厂的一名中国工头带领，前往义勇队总部要求释放此人，在被拒绝后制造了骚乱。义勇队开了约15枪（手枪和步枪），严重击伤了一名苦力，该人被送往红十字会医院。一名义勇队员腹股沟部位中弹受伤
